name: usage-guard-collector
description: Read-only Cloudflare usage collector: pulls daily Workers / D1 / DO / KV / R2 / Queues counts from GraphQL Analytics into your own D1 and flags spikes.

scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply USAGE --remote && wrangler deploy

USAGE.description: D1 database that holds `usage_daily`. Created for you; the migration runs as part of the deploy step.

CF_ACCOUNT_ID.description: The 32-character hex id of the account to watch. It is the id in your dashboard URL: `dash.cloudflare.com/<this>`.

CF_API_TOKEN.description: An API token with **Account Analytics: Read** only. Create it at [dash.cloudflare.com/profile/api-tokens](https://dash.cloudflare.com/profile/api-tokens) with a custom token; no other permission is needed and the Worker never calls a write API.

THRESHOLDS_JSON.description: Optional. Leave empty for the defaults. JSON object of per-metric floors, e.g. `{"d1.rows_read": 1000000}`.
